name: AttnRes-Canon
tagline: Every block its own depth source, and short causal convolutions on every sublayer input, on q, k, v and in the MLP.
description: Full AttnRes, one group per block, so each sublayer reads the embedding and every earlier block's output separately, with Canon layers at all four positions: on every sublayer input, on q, k and v, and in the MLP. Canon weights start at zero. The 138 Canon layers (six per block) add 1,271,808 parameters; calibrated to +0.486% of the shared budget at 23 layers / FFN 6144.
paperTitle: Physics of Language Models: Part 4.1, Architecture Design and the Magic of Canon Layers
mechanism: Full AttnRes: 23 depth groups of one block; zero-initialized pseudo-queries over the embedding and every block output
Canon-A/C: a 4-tap causal depthwise convolution with a residual on every attention and FFN input
Canon-B on q, k, v and Canon-D on the 6144-wide MLP hidden; all Canon weights start at zero
limitations: Found by an LLM agent with NextT-Gym in arena v1 (involvement L1) and selected on the dev split at a 2,000-update prefix with one seed. The gym's selection measured −0.00380 BPB against attnres at that prefix; the formal run measured −0.00244 periodic validation BPB against attnres at 46,875 updates. Both are single-seed observations. The Canon layers are eager PyTorch depthwise convolutions without fused kernels: in the gym trainer one update took 1.66 times attnres's time, a property of this implementation rather than of the method. Parameters, memory and speed are outcomes, not controls.
